decision: Car 87 is required to start the Race from the pit lane and follow the procedures prescribed in Article 44.2.
fact: The Team did not cover car 87 two hours after the chequered flag of the qualifying session and the following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) 5th Turbo Charger (TC) 5th Motor Generator Unit - Heat (MGU-H) 5th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) 6th Engine Exhaust System (EX) All Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Ferme.
offence: Breaches of Articles 28.2, 40.6 and 40.9a of the 2025 Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Car 87 is required to start the Race from the pit lane and follow the procedures prescribed in Article 44.2.
reason: In light of the above facts, the Formula One Sporting Regulations precribe the penalties to be applied for the two breaches. While the penalty for a breach of Article 28.2 is the appropriate number of grid places prescribed by Article 28.3, in this case, because the changes were made without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate and because the competitor made the changes during parc ferme and failed to comply with Article 40.6, the penalty to be applied is the one prescribed by Article 40.9(a), namely a pit lane start. We accordingly imposed the said penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
